homepage.body:
<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="uk" dir="ltr" class data-widget-pool="weather currency horoscope predictions radio" data-beasties-container><head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="metrix:release" content="front-07075af7">
    <title>Новини 24 – останні новини України та світу, події, свіжі репортажі, ТБ ефір каналу – 24 Канал</title>
    <base href="/">
    <!-- viewport-fit=cover is what makes env(safe-area-inset-*) report real
         values on iOS; without it they are all 0 and every inset in the app is
         dead code. Everything pinned to a screen edge must clear the insets
         itself — see body padding in styles.css and the fixed stacks in
         layout.html. -->
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">

    <!-- Who is reading, guessed before the first frame so the header's cabinet
         button is drawn for the right reader: the page is cached per URL and
         cannot say, the session cookies can. `hasSession` carries a value —
         `1` a session exists, `0` the proxy looked and there is none. The button's stylesheet reads `data-auth`, and
         AuthInitializerService swaps the guess for the answer once auth has one,
         so a wrong guess costs a single swap and no JS at all draws the guest.
         The coin pill is drawn from the last visit's count, if there is one. -->
    <script>
      (function (root) {
        var member = /(?:^|;\s*)(?:hasSession=1|accessToken=[^;\s])/.test(document.cookie);
        root.setAttribute('data-auth', member ? 'member' : 'guest');
        // A weather city the reader picked, Kyiv aside: the server draws Kyiv for
        // everyone and widget-hold.css keeps it hidden until theirs comes
        // (24tv/24tv.front#54). Cookie name and id are SETTLEMENT_COOKIE and
        // DEFAULT_SETTLEMENT_ID in weather-settlement.service.ts.
        var city = /(?:^|;\s*)user_settlement_id=(\d+)/.exec(document.cookie);
        if (city && city[1] !== '10868') root.setAttribute('data-own-weather', '');
        // The member's last coin count, so the header pill stands from the first
        // frame instead of opening seconds later (24tv/24tv.front#296). Key is
        // COINS_HINT_KEY in core/utils/coins-hint.ts; only compactCoins' shape gets in.
        try {
          var coins = member && localStorage.getItem('coinsHint');
          if (coins && /^\d+(?:\.\d)?[KM]?$/.test(coins)) {
            root.style.setProperty('--coins-hint', '"' + coins + '"');
            root.setAttribute('data-coins', '');
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      })(document.documentElement);
    </script>
    <!-- The home page's phone strip leads with a card drawn by lot
         (24tv/24tv.front#391). The server writes which cards may lead
         (`data-widget-pool`) and never which does: the page is cached by URL,
         one draw would be everyone's. Drawn here, before the first frame, so
         widget-slider.css stands the cards in place without a shift. Names
         are POOL_ATTR / LEAD_ATTR in strip-lead.ts. -->
    <script data-widget-lead>
      (function (root) {
        var pool = (root.getAttribute('data-widget-pool') || '').split(' ').filter(function (name) {
          return /^[a-z]+$/.test(name);
        });
        if (pool.length)
          root.setAttribute('data-widget-lead', pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]);
      })(document.documentElement);
    </script>
    <!-- The app's dark mode on its article screen (24tv/24tv.front#287): the app
         says so only by `?theme=dark` and never sets the class there itself.
         Here, before the first frame, and not on the server: the proxy caches
         that path per URL without its query, so one dark render would be served
         to every reader. The path rule is `isWebviewArticlePath`'s. -->
    <script data-app-theme>
      (function (root, loc) {
        var locale = '(?:(?:uk|ru|en)\\/)?';
        var article = new RegExp('^\\/' + locale + 'mobile\\/' + locale + 'infnews\\/\\d+\\/?$');
        if (article.test(loc.pathname) && new URLSearchParams(loc.search).get('theme') === 'dark')
          root.classList.add('dark');
      })(document.documentElement, location);
    </script>
    <!-- The globals and presses article HTML from the CMS calls into, alive from the
         first frame: the page can be pressed seconds before the app starts, and a
         press then would be lost, or follow the link to the sign-up page
         (community24/molfar-24/molfar-24-api#174). Here they only wait; everything
         they wait for is `provideArticleBridges`. -->
    <script data-article-bridges>
      (function (win, doc, userAgent) {
        var waiting = [];
        var inFlight = {};
        var actions = null;
        var appDeadline = 0;
        // An impatient reader pressing twice while the first press is still on
        // its way gets one popup, on either side of the app starting.
        function run(name, args) {
          var key = JSON.stringify([name, args]);
          if (inFlight[key]) return inFlight[key];
          var promise = !actions
            ? new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                waiting.push({
                  name: name,
                  args: args,
                  key: key,
                  appHooked: !!win.__ltHuntHook,
                  resolve: resolve,
                  reject: reject,
                });
              })
            : dispatch(name, args, key, !!win.__ltHuntHook);
          function clear() {
            if (inFlight[key] === promise) delete inFlight[key];
          }
          inFlight[key] = promise;
          promise.then(clear, clear);
          return promise;
        }
        function action(name) {
          return function () {
            return run(name, [].slice.call(arguments));
          };
        }
        // Nobody takes the result of these, so a failure must reach the error
        // listener on its own: `then` with no handler leaves it unhandled.
        function press(name) {
          var call = action(name);
          return function () {
            call.apply(null, arguments).then();
          };
        }
        // 24tv.mobileapp wraps completeAction once the page has loaded: native
        // sign-in for a guest, the coin balance for a member. A find pressed
        // before that waits for the wrapper (`__ltHuntHook`, one_news.dart). An
        // app version without one costs the first press 10 s, later ones nothing.
        function awaitsApp(name, hooked) {
          return (
            name === 'completeAction' &&
            !hooked &&
            userAgent.indexOf('24tvApp/') !== -1 &&
            (!appDeadline || Date.now() < appDeadline)
          );
        }
        function throughApp(key, args) {
          appDeadline = appDeadline || Date.now() + 10000;
          return new Promise(function (resolve) {
            var timer = setInterval(function () {
              if (!win.__ltHuntHook && Date.now() < appDeadline) return;
              clearInterval(timer);
              delete inFlight[key];
              resolve(win.tv24GameBridge.completeAction.apply(null, args));
            }, 250);
          });
        }
        function dispatch(name, args, key, hooked) {
          return awaitsApp(name, hooked) ? throughApp(key, args) : actions[name].apply(null, args);
        }
        win.tv24GameBridge = {
          completeAction: action('completeAction'),
          isActionAvailable: action('isActionAvailable'),
        };
        win.tv24LoyaltyPromoBridge = { participate: press('participate') };
        win.tv24TelegramDigestBridge = {
          linkTelegram: press('linkTelegram'),
          openInterestsPopup: press('openInterests'),
        };
        // Capture, and the press goes no further: the embed is usually a link,
        // and the CMS's own handlers must not follow it.
        doc.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function (event) {
            var target = event.target;
            if (!target || !target.closest) return;
            var name = target.closest('[data-loyalty-promo]')
              ? 'participate'
              : target.closest('[data-predictions-auth]')
                ? 'predictionsSignIn'
                : null;
            if (!name) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            run(name, []).then();
          },
          true
        );
        win.tv24ConnectArticleBridges = function (ready) {
          actions = ready;
          waiting.forEach(function (call) {
            dispatch(call.name, call.args, call.key, call.appHooked).then(
              call.resolve,
              call.reject
            );
          });
          waiting = [];
        };
      })(window, document, navigator.userAgent);
    </script>
    <!-- A stopgap for pages released apps embed at their public address and only a
         store review could move to `/mobile` (24tv/24tv.front#386). Here, before the
         first frame, and not on the server: the proxy caches the page per URL, so one
         render without the chrome would be served to every reader. Hidden, not left
         out, so hydration finds the server's DOM. `!important`: the stylesheets load
         after this and set the same tokens. The 75px is what the app kept clear below
         these pages. To cover another section, add it to the path's alternation. -->
    <script data-app-embed>
      (function (doc, path, userAgent) {
        if (userAgent.indexOf('24tvApp/') === -1) return;
        if (!/^\/(?:(?:uk|ru|en)\/)?(?:online)(?:\/|$)/.test(path)) return;
        var style = doc.createElement('style');
        style.textContent =
          ':root{--header-height:0px!important;--mobile-menu-height:0px!important;' +
          '--app-bottom-inset:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 75px)!important}' +
          'header[app-header],[data-footer-slot],nav[app-mobile-menu],nav[app-breadcrumbs]' +
          '{display:none!important}';
        doc.head.appendChild(style);
      })(document, location.pathname, navigator.userAgent);
    </script>
    <!-- Slovko's load splash, on only when the board would jump from the
         server's five columns to a stored length — why: slovko-splash.ts.
         Key and lengths are WORD_LENGTH_KEY and WORD_LENGTHS in word-length.ts. -->
    <script data-slovko-splash>
      (function (root, loc) {
        if (!/^\/(?:mobile\/)?slovko\/?$/.test(loc.pathname)) return;
        try {
          var store = window.localStorage;
          if (!/^(?:4|[6-9]|1[01])$/.test(store.getItem('slovko:wordLength') || '')) return;
          var today = new Date().toDateString();
          var seen = store.getItem('slovko:splashDay') === today;
          if (!seen) store.setItem('slovko:splashDay', today);
          root.setAttribute('data-slovko-splash', seen ? 'short' : 'full');
          root.setAttribute('data-slovko-splash-at', String(Math.round(performance.now())));
        } catch (e) {}
      })(document.documentElement, location);
    </script>
    

    <!-- Site-wide and constant, so they live here rather than in the SEO
         document: the writer only ever touches tags it put there itself, which
         is what lets these survive every navigation (docs/seo.spec.md B11). -->
    <meta property="fb:admins" content="100002197865474">
    <meta property="fb:app_id" content="149318671801286">
    <style>
      /* Arial dressed as Fira for the frames before the webfont lands, so the swap
         changes neither line breaks nor how heavy the text looks (#249).
         - Face: local() picks one exact face, and a face that declares the
           requested weight is drawn as-is, never synthetically bolded — so each
           weight names the Arial it draws with.
           By ink per glyph Fira Regular sits next to Arial Regular, while Fira
           Medium and up, and both Extra Condensed weights, sit next to Arial Bold.
         - size-adjust: Fira width / Arial width over Ukrainian article text.
           All Fira weights share one advance width; Arial Bold is ~8% wider.
           Extra Condensed 500 is measured over capitals: it draws the uppercase
           labels (СПЕЦПРОЄКТ, РЕКЛАМА), and Fira capitals run ~6% narrower
           against Arial than mixed-case text does.
         - ascent/descent: Fira's 0.935 / 0.265 divided by size-adjust.
         Re-measure if the font files change. */
      @font-face {
        font-family: 'Fira Sans Fallback';
        src: local('Arial'), local('ArialMT');
        font-weight: 400;
        size-adjust: 102.4%;
        ascent-override: 91.3%;
        descent-override: 25.9%;
        line-gap-override: 0%;
        font-display: swap;
      }

      @font-face {
        font-family: 'Fira Sans Fallback';
        src: local('Arial Bold'), local('Arial-BoldMT');
        font-weight: 500 800;
        size-adjust: 94.9%;
        ascent-override: 98.5%;
        descent-override: 27.9%;
        line-gap-override: 0%;
        font-display: swap;
      }

      @font-face {
        font-family: 'Fira Sans Extra Condensed Fallback';
        src: local('Arial Bold'), local('Arial-BoldMT');
        font-weight: 400;
        size-adjust: 78.5%;
        ascent-override: 119.1%;
        descent-override: 33.8%;
        line-gap-override: 0%;
        font-display: swap;
      }

      @font-face {
        font-family: 'Fira Sans Extra Condensed Fallback';
        src: local('Arial Bold'), local('Arial-BoldMT');
        font-weight: 500;
        size-adjust: 74.2%;
        ascent-override: 126%;
        descent-override: 35.7%;
        line-gap-override: 0%;
        font-display: swap;
      }

      /* Boot loader for client-rendered routes (community/**, see
         app.routes.server.ts): the server ships this index untouched, so it
         is what a visitor sees until the app has booted and settled the
         session. Server-rendered routes replace it before it ever shows.
         Colours mirror --color-background-50 / --color-channel-primary-500 —
         the theme is not loaded yet, so they have to be literal here. */
      .app-boot-loader {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        background: #f8f7f4;
      }

      /* Same literal-colour reasoning as above, for the dark theme the mobile
         app sets by putting the `dark` class on <html>. */
      :root.dark .app-boot-loader {
        background: #1c1a17;
      }

      .app-boot-loader__spinner {
        width: 48px;
        height: 48px;
        border: 4px solid #f3f3f3;
        border-top-color: #d11831;
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: app-boot-spin 1s linear infinite;
      }

      @keyframes app-boot-spin {
        to {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }
    </style>
